queries.purpose: Menampilkan ringkasan customer dengan outstanding invoice terbesar, termasuk total invoice, outstanding, invoice belum lunas, dan total retur penjualan.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.knama AS customer_nama, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi) AS total_invoice, SUM(COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_terbayar, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, COALESCE(sr.total_retur, 0) AS total_retur_penjualan, COALESCE(sr.jumlah_retur, 0) AS jumlah_dokumen_retur FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid AND c.kaktif = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT srcustomer, COUNT(srid) AS jumlah_retur, SUM(srtotaltransaksi) AS total_retur FROM m5_sr GROUP BY srcustomer ) sr ON si.sicustomer = sr.srcustomer WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND si.sicustomer = ( SELECT x.sicustomer FROM ( SELECT sicustomer, SUM(sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si WHERE siisclose = 0 GROUP BY sicustomer ORDER BY total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ) GROUP BY c.kid, c.knama, sr.total_retur, sr.jumlah_retur
